title: Roxanne S NDE 828
content:
I watched the little girl's body from above, as if in the tree. Then I was transported to a wondrous landscape where all my feelings and events of my life happened at once. I wrote a book about it, 'The Wave of Light', to try to describe it all, but the most recent thing I wrote is: Here on a visit in particle state life unfolds in time and space Eternity glimpsed in dreams quiet moments and bliss Home we go to wave state time and space mere concepts of these particles

I watched the little girl's body from above, as if in the tree. Then I was transported to a wondrous landscape where all my feelings and events of my life happened at once. I wrote a book about it, 'The Wave of Light', to try to describe it all, but the most recent thing I wrote is:

Here

on a visit

in particle state

life unfolds

in time and space

Eternity

glimpsed in dreams

quiet moments

and bliss

Home we go

to wave state

time and space

mere concepts

of these particles

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Hit by car, unconscious for three days in hospital, suffered from concussion and pain (broken arm) for about a year.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Watched the little girl's body (mine) in the street and a woman getting out of a car, screaming (her car had hit me). Was very detached from the scene.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Understood that our perception of time and space...
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Beautiful music coming from everywhere and everything.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Total darkness into total light.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Being who first appeared as unconditional loving unisex being became my deceased grandfather as I moved into the experience.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Seems that everything was made of light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Castles and flowers made of clouds, emotions and ethereal substance of some kind.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Our perception of time and space is limited by our physical existence - that existence is enhanced when the body is left behind, but we still do not see it all - can't from this perspective but will when we return to all that is...
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw that everything I felt, say, and do has an impact on everything.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Since I 'know' that linear time is not valid, it sometimes seems (during meditation or sometimes when I'm least expecting it) that all is happening at once.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Saw my younger brother on Earth and understood how much he needed me in his life.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Many over the years, last one a month ago where, in a dreamlike meditative state I saw all events of all that was, is and ever will be coming together into one point of light - emotions to geometric forms all merging into a pinpoint very clearly and I said out loud 'I get it' and came back into consciousness. Now very hard to describe but this is the best I can do.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best, seeing that everything is connected. Worst, coming back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Countless conversations about life, nature of being, NDEs, quantum mechanics, everything!
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Death of my grandmother where she took me to similar 'landscape' (1974). Three LSD experiences similar but not as intense (1976, 1981, 1997) After major operation (1991) was visited by a being of light that told me I would be fine.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Second NDE when I nearly drowned at seventeen years old in Newport Beach, California.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Thank you! It's good to be reminded of all of this. In 1997, after birth of my first grandchild, I focused hard on moving my body from Oregon to Colorado and related physical day-to-day stuff. Numerous deep experiences in the past year have re-immersed me in all of this too. Guess you could say I'm having my cake and eating it too right now.
